problem.title: Hometask

semantics: Line 1: nonempty lowercase s, |s|<=10^5 (exponent attested from public English statement). Line 2: integer k 0..13. Next k lines: two different lowercase letters, every letter in at most one pair; pairs are unordered. Unique integer: minimum deletions so no forbidden pair is adjacent. Oracle: for every maximal run consisting only of the two letters of one pair, delete the rarer letter (min of the two counts); runs are independent because other letters are never worth deleting. Independently checked by exhaustive kept-subsequence enumeration and a separate last-kept-letter dynamic program.
